# Plus Care Plan

The Plus care plan covers mechanical and electrical faults arising from
normal domestic use. The warranty period is 24 months from the date of
delivery, covering parts and labour.

An engineer visit under the Plus plan carries a call-out fee of £15 per
visit. Approved repairs are completed within 5 working days of the first
visit; where a repair is not economical the unit is replaced with the same
or an equivalent model.

The plan excludes accidental damage, cosmetic wear, and any repair carried
out by anyone other than an approved engineer. Claims are made through the
support portal with the order number to hand.
